description: Spec §8.2: the level's rock (centred SM_DF_RockWall) stands on the shortcut's road top, 4 m tall as before. A 3 m test rock's Demolish spawns 8 BP_DFDebris (the restart before swept every earlier one), all within 150 cm of its centre (a 2 x 2 x 2 grid over its bounds); a chunk is SM_DF_RockChunk sized to its cell, simulates physics as a PhysicsBody that ignores pawns and cars, and has an 8 s life span. 9 s later none is left.
